page_title: BAR 1-0 MAL | Barcelona v Mallorca 08/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' A lofted pass finds Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the left post.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
87' Here comes a substitution. Ilkay Gundogan is given a rest as he is replaced by Oriol Romeu (Barcelona).
86' Javier Iglesias Villanueva shows a yellow card to Samu Costa (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
82' Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Jose Copete is replaced by Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca).
82' It's time for a substitution. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) comes on in place of Cyle Larin.
80' The ratio of the ball possession is 66:34.
76' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
73' 1 - 0 Goal! Robert Lewandowski slips it to Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) on the edge of the box and he finds the top left corner with a great effort. The score is 1:0.
73' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
71' Javier Aguirre decides to make a substitution. Sergi Darder will be replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jaume Costa (Mallorca) is coming onto the pitch as Toni Lato cannot continue after picking up an injury.

69' Vitor Roque (Barcelona) meets a cross from Robert Lewandowski, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
67' The current number of shots on goal is 6:3.
65' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Mallorca have a free kick.
64' It looks like Samu Costa (Mallorca) saw red with that tackle. Javier Iglesias Villanueva won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Barcelona win a free kick.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Vitor Roque (Barcelona) comes onto the pitch so that Joao Felix can be given a rest.
61' Oscar Hernandez has decided to substitute Marc Guiu and he is replaced by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona).
61' Javier Aguirre has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) replacing Manu Morlanes.

60' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Predrag Rajkovic pulls off an easy save.
57' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the crossbar! A few inches lower and it could have been a sweet goal!

57' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
57' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

54' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His almost perfect header hits the bar and ricochets away off it. Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
53' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
50' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
49' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
49' Barcelona spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.

48' He should have scored! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Marc-Andre ter Stegen makes an easy save.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+1' The referee points to the corner flag and Barcelona will take a corner.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

45' Predrag Rajkovic makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) after a cross from the side. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.

43' Dangerous play by Andreas Christensen (Barcelona). Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
41' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Predrag Rajkovic.

40' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
38' Marc-Andre ter Stegen makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) after a cross from the side.
37' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Raphinha (Barcelona) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Fermin Lopez.

35' Joao Felix (Barcelona) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
34' It will be a corner kick for Mallorca.

34' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mallorca.

31' Sergi Darder floats in a cross for Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
30' A clumsy foul by Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle. A free kick to Barcelona.
29' Raphinha (Barcelona) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
29' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
26' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
25' Samu Costa (Mallorca) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.

24' Predrag Rajkovic anticipates the direction of the penalty by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
24' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is going to take the penalty!
23' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Barcelona!
22' Referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Barcelona. Let’s see what happens!
21' Raphinha (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
19' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' A player from Barcelona commits a rough challenge. Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick has been awarded to Mallorca.
15' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Barcelona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' Javier Iglesias Villanueva has a clear sight and sees a foul from Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca). Barcelona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
14' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
12' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is caught offside!
10' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mallorca was in an offside position.
8' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
7' Samu Costa (Mallorca) jumps into a tackle and Javier Iglesias Villanueva signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Barcelona.
6' Javier Iglesias Villanueva interrupts the game. One of the players from Mallorca won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Barcelona are awarded the free kick.
5' The ball is cleared after Cyle Larin (Mallorca) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' Some patient build-up play from Barcelona as they look to unlock the defence.

4' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Predrag Rajkovic!
4' Raphinha (Barcelona) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
1' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) commits a rough foul. Javier Iglesias Villanueva stops the game and makes a call. Barcelona get a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Mallorca will kick the game off.
Javier Iglesias Villanueva was nominated as the referee for this game.
